7cdbe8bb-8efa-4541-9835-170efd083c70.learn: Which rock property is the fraction of its bulk volume occupied by pore space?
7cdbe8bb-8efa-4541-9835-170efd083c70.quiz: Divide a rock sample's void volume by its total bulk volume. What property have you calculated?
7cdbe8bb-8efa-4541-9835-170efd083c70.explanation: Porosity is pore volume divided by bulk rock volume, often expressed as a percentage. It measures storage space. Permeability measures the ability to transmit fluid, so high porosity alone does not guarantee good flow.

notes: Authored independent prompts for the pore-volume fraction and distinguished it from permeability.

3f2273ab-851f-49cd-a34e-6ca68e8ef6c2.learn: Which rock property describes its ability to transmit fluid through connected pores under a pressure gradient?
3f2273ab-851f-49cd-a34e-6ca68e8ef6c2.quiz: Two rocks can have the same porosity but different fluid-flow capacity. Which property describes that capacity and is commonly reported in millidarcies?
3f2273ab-851f-49cd-a34e-6ca68e8ef6c2.explanation: Permeability describes a porous material's ability to transmit fluid. Darcy's law relates flow rate to permeability, flow area, viscosity, pressure gradient, and path length. It is not simply the pore-volume fraction or a travel time.

notes: Corrected the source's overly simple travel-time description and authored two rock-flow-specific prompts.

bffc9261-334b-41e2-bd3e-a2effaa981f6.learn: Which fold type has its oldest rocks in the core and, when upright, forms an upward-convex arch?
bffc9261-334b-41e2-bd3e-a2effaa981f6.quiz: In an upright fold, the beds arch upward and become older toward the centre. Name the fold.
bffc9261-334b-41e2-bd3e-a2effaa981f6.explanation: An anticline has older rocks toward its core. An upright anticline is arch shaped. Its geometry may support a petroleum trap when reservoir rock, seal, closure, charge, and timing are also suitable.

notes: Specified upright geometry and age relationship; did not equate every anticline with a proven petroleum trap.

8bc240e2-c01b-4e7e-83cc-df48faf4c628.learn: Which fold type has its youngest rocks in the core and, when upright, forms a trough?
8bc240e2-c01b-4e7e-83cc-df48faf4c628.quiz: Beds in an upright fold curve downward and become younger toward the centre. What is this fold called?
8bc240e2-c01b-4e7e-83cc-df48faf4c628.explanation: A syncline has younger rocks toward its core. When upright, its geometry is trough shaped. Age relationships distinguish anticlines and synclines even where subsequent deformation complicates their present orientation.

notes: Used age relationships and qualified the upright geometry rather than treating shape alone as sufficient.
